hooks.command: sh -c 'root="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"; ver="$(timeout "${RED_SKILLS_HOOK_TIMEOUT_S:-30s}" node -e "process.stdout.write(require(process.argv[1]).version)" "$root/.claude-plugin/plugin.json" 2>/dev/null)"; if [ -n "$ver" ]; then for f in "$root/hooks/red-fetch.mjs" "$root/dist/red-fetch.mjs" "$root/../../dist/red-fetch.mjs"; do [ -f "$f" ] && { timeout "${RED_SKILLS_HOOK_TIMEOUT_S:-30s}" node "$f" dev "$ver" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; timeout "${RED_SKILLS_HOOK_TIMEOUT_S:-30s}" node "$f" code-nav "$ver" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; break; }; done; fi; printf "{}"'

sh -c 'tmp="$(mktemp)"; trap "rm -f "$tmp"" EXIT; timeout "${RED_SKILLS_HOOK_STDIN_TIMEOUT_S:-5s}" cat >"$tmp" 2>/dev/null || true; find_rsp_bundle() { for root in "${RED_SKILLS_DEV_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" "${CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" "${OPENCODE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}"; do [ -n "$root" ] || continue; for f in "$root/../../dist/rsp.bundle.min.mjs" "$root/dist/rsp.bundle.min.mjs"; do [ -f "$f" ] && { printf "%s
" "$f"; return 0; }; done; done; latest="$(for dir in "$HOME"/.codex/plugins/cache/red-skills/dev/* "$HOME"/.claude/plugins/cache/red-skills/dev/*; do [ -d "$dir" ] || continue; for f in "$dir/../../dist/rsp.bundle.min.mjs" "$dir/dist/rsp.bundle.min.mjs"; do [ -f "$f" ] && printf "%s	%s
" "$(basename "$dir")" "$f"; done; done | sort -V | tail -1 | cut -f2-)"; [ -n "$latest" ] && { printf "%s
" "$latest"; return 0; }; cache_root="${RED_SKILLS_CACHE_DIR:-${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/red-skills/bundles}"; latest="$(for f in "$cache_root"/.staging-rsp-*/node_modules/@reddb-io/red-skills/dist/rsp.bundle.min.mjs; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; dir="${f%/node_modules/@reddb-io/red-skills/dist/rsp.bundle.min.mjs}"; ver="${dir##*/.staging-rsp-}"; printf "%s	%s
" "$ver" "$f"; done | sort -V | tail -1 | cut -f2-)"; [ -n "$latest" ] && { printf "%s
" "$latest"; return 0; }; [ -f "$cache_root/rsp.bundle.min.mjs" ] && { printf "%s
" "$cache_root/rsp.bundle.min.mjs"; return 0; }; latest="$(for f in "$cache_root"/rsp-*.bundle.min.mjs; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; ver="${f##*/rsp-}"; ver="${ver%.bundle.min.mjs}"; printf "%s	%s
" "$ver" "$f"; done | sort -V | tail -1 | cut -f2-)"; [ -n "$latest" ] && { printf "%s
" "$latest"; return 0; }; return 1; }; find_red_binary() { cache_root="${RED_SKILLS_CACHE_DIR:-${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/red-skills/bundles}"; latest="$(for red in "$cache_root"/reddb/*/red "$cache_root"/reddb/*/red.exe; do [ -x "$red" ] || continue; ver="${red%/*}"; ver="${ver##*/}"; printf "%s	%s
" "$ver" "$red"; done | sort -V | tail -1 | cut -f2-)"; [ -n "$latest" ] && printf "%s
" "$latest"; }; f="$(find_rsp_bundle || true)"; red="$(find_red_binary || true)"; [ -n "$f" ] && { if [ -n "$red" ]; then REDDB_BIN="$red" timeout "${RED_SKILLS_HOOK_TIMEOUT_S:-30s}" node "$f" hook claude-pre-exec <"$tmp" || exit 0; else timeout "${RED_SKILLS_HOOK_TIMEOUT_S:-30s}" node "$f" hook claude-pre-exec <"$tmp" || exit 0; fi; exit 0; }; exit 0'

sh -c 'tmp="$(mktemp)"; trap "rm -f \"$tmp\"" EXIT; timeout "${RED_SKILLS_HOOK_STDIN_TIMEOUT_S:-5s}" cat >"$tmp" 2>/dev/null || true; hook="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/misc/branch-lock/scripts/branch-lock-hook.sh"; if [ -f "$hook" ]; then bash "$hook" <"$tmp" || printf "{}"; else printf "{}"; fi'

sh -c 'tmp="$(mktemp)"; trap "rm -f \"$tmp\"" EXIT; timeout "${RED_SKILLS_HOOK_STDIN_TIMEOUT_S:-5s}" cat >"$tmp" 2>/dev/null || true; hook="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/command-guard.sh"; if [ -x "$hook" ]; then "$hook" <"$tmp" || printf "{}"; else printf "{}"; fi'

sh -c 'tmp="$(mktemp)"; trap "rm -f \"$tmp\"" EXIT; timeout "${RED_SKILLS_HOOK_STDIN_TIMEOUT_S:-5s}" cat >"$tmp" 2>/dev/null || true; root="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"; out=""; for f in "$root/hooks/red-fetch.mjs" "$root/dist/red-fetch.mjs" "$root/../../dist/red-fetch.mjs"; do [ -f "$f" ] && { out="$(timeout "${RED_SKILLS_HOOK_TIMEOUT_S:-30s}" node "$f" run dev route-model-tier --host claude <"$tmp" 2>/dev/null)"; break; }; done; if [ -n "$out" ]; then printf "%s" "$out"; else printf "{}"; fi'
